 . 16. Wrong Item and Incorrect Quantity Policy

fulfillment error.
The customer should provide the order number and, where requested, a photo of the received item and shipping
label. Nimbus Commerce may arrange a free reverse pickup and ship the correct product if available.
If the customer received fewer units than ordered, support should check whether the order was intentionally split
into multiple shipments. If no second shipment exists, the missing quantity is treated as a fulfillment discrepancy.
